section_summary: This section centers on the postwar yen-dollar exchange rate. It includes the State-War-Navy Coordinating Committee’s decision to authorize a military conversion rate of 50 yen per dollar, supported by price tables and an analysis of exchange parity. Other documents address remittances to Japan, French and Italian deposits at the Yokohama Specie Bank, individual claims, and RCA Communications’ difficulty converting Korean won into dollars.

subfiles.title: Telegram on news agencies’ yen and dollar payments
subfiles.about: Sets conditions for dollar payments and conversion arrangements for news and cultural agencies in Japan.
subfiles.summary: Confirms limits on yen conversion and proposes prorated payments within a million-dollar ceiling.

subfiles.title: Memorandum for files on remittance license applications
subfiles.about: Explains why a letter to Treasury’s Foreign Funds Control was prepared.
subfiles.summary: Records the Department’s response to Treasury inquiries about pending remittances to Japan.

subfiles.title: Letter on licenses for remittances to Japan
subfiles.about: Offers State Department guidance on Treasury licenses for sending funds to Japan.
subfiles.summary: Generally permits religious, charitable, and educational remittances. Requests consultation about business, investment, financial, and other private remittances.

subfiles.title: Foreign Missions Conference request for a revised exchange rate
subfiles.about: Requests an equitable yen-dollar exchange rate for missionary and relief work.
subfiles.summary: Forwards a conference resolution, citing hardship for work in Japan and Korea.

subfiles.title: Foreign Missions Conference resolution on yen-dollar exchange
subfiles.from: Foreign Missions Conference of North America
subfiles.about: Calls for revision of the 15-to-1 yen-dollar exchange rate.
subfiles.summary: Argues that the rate impedes missionaries and Christian institutions in Japan.

subfiles.title: Reply to Wynn C. Fairfield on exchange rates
subfiles.from: Edwin M. Martin, for the Secretary of State
subfiles.about: Responds to the conference’s request for a revised yen-dollar exchange rate.
subfiles.summary: Acknowledges hardship facing religious and relief organizations in Japan and Korea and says the exchange-rate question is under study.

subfiles.title: Transmittal of policy statement to the Treasury Secretary
subfiles.about: Conveys the approved policy conclusions on the yen-dollar military conversion rate.
subfiles.summary: The enclosed statement rejects SCAP’s full proposed increase and favors producer subsidies and more household imports.

subfiles.title: Memorandum for the U.S. member of the Far Eastern Commission
subfiles.to: United States member, Far Eastern Commission
subfiles.about: Transmits the approved exchange-rate policy conclusions.
subfiles.summary: Sends the substance of SWNCC 343/1 for the commission member’s information.

subfiles.title: SWNCC memorandum forwarding approved paper
subfiles.from: J. H. Hilldring, State-War-Navy Coordinating Committee
subfiles.about: Forwards the approved SWNCC 343/1 paper and requests its distribution.
subfiles.summary: Asks State to notify Treasury and the U.S. Far Eastern Commission representative.

subfiles.title: Revision of Yen-Dollar Military Conversion Rate, SWNCC 343/1
subfiles.doc_type: committee report with annexes, tables, intelligence memorandum, and draft cable
subfiles.about: Evaluates SCAP’s request to raise the military conversion rate from 15 to 75 yen per dollar for Japan and Korea.
subfiles.summary: The committee recommends 50 yen per dollar, citing inflation risks and uncertainty about a future commercial rate. Annexes reproduce SCAP’s proposal, War Department instructions, price and wage tables, and an intelligence study finding wide variation in possible exchange parities. A draft cable authorizes the new rate and proposes subsidies for Japanese goods sold through post exchanges.

subfiles.title: Transmittal of SWNCC exchange-rate paper to Tokyo
subfiles.to: United States Political Adviser to SCAP, Tokyo
subfiles.about: Sends an approved copy of SWNCC 343/1.
subfiles.summary: Forwards the exchange-rate paper for the Political Adviser’s information.

subfiles.title: Inquiry about deposits at the Yokohama Specie Bank
subfiles.about: Asks about several bank deposits held in Japan.
subfiles.summary: Lists deposit numbers and asks what can be done with the funds.

subfiles.title: Reply concerning Yokohama Specie Bank deposits
subfiles.about: Explains restrictions on converting or transferring deposits held in Japan.
subfiles.summary: Says no official conversion rate exists and suggests asking the bank for information.

subfiles.title: Disposition of French and Italian yen balances in Japan
subfiles.doc_type: memorandum and policy paper with cable appendices
subfiles.from: J. H. Hilldring, State Department member of SWNCC
subfiles.about: Proposes treatment of French and Italian government deposits at the Yokohama Specie Bank.
subfiles.summary: The paper distinguishes wartime trade proceeds from diplomatic and governmental funds that may merit protection during Japanese bank reorganization. It recommends moving qualifying French and Italian balances into protected restricted accounts and considers limited releases. Attached cables document account histories, SCAP’s objections, and proposed instructions.

subfiles.title: Paris Embassy despatch transmitting Bagulesco’s claim
subfiles.about: Forwards General Georges Bagulesco’s letter seeking recovery of funds in Japan.
subfiles.summary: Transmits Bagulesco’s letter for action and records acknowledgment of its receipt.

subfiles.title: Georges Bagulesco’s letter seeking reimbursement
subfiles.about: Requests repayment of Swiss francs deposited through the Yokohama Specie Bank in Tokyo.
subfiles.summary: The former Romanian minister says the bank converted his 47,500 Swiss francs into yen and that Japanese authorities then withheld payment. He asks for reimbursement in Swiss francs or equivalent U.S. dollars.

subfiles.title: Department communication to the American Mission in Paris
subfiles.to: Officer in Charge, American Mission, Paris
subfiles.about: Addresses Bagulesco’s claim; the body is largely illegible in the OCR.
subfiles.summary: Outgoing communication concerning the Bagulesco correspondence.

subfiles.title: Department transmittal of Bagulesco claim to Tokyo
subfiles.to: United States Political Adviser for Japan, Tokyo
subfiles.about: Refers Bagulesco’s letter to occupation authorities for consideration.
subfiles.summary: Requests that the Political Adviser bring the deposit claim to General Headquarters.

subfiles.title: Donald P. La Tourette’s currency exchange inquiry
subfiles.about: Asks for payment on a receipt from a 1942 wartime exchange aboard the Asama Maru.
subfiles.summary: Seeks U.S. currency for a receipt covering piastres and Thai baht.

subfiles.title: Cross-reference sheet
subfiles.about: Records a transfer or cross-reference between decimal-file entries.
subfiles.summary: Administrative cross-reference sheet with file numbers and a transfer date.

subfiles.title: RCA cover letter on Korean won conversion
subfiles.about: Encloses RCA’s request for help converting Korean won into dollars.
subfiles.summary: Requests State Department assistance with RCA’s Korean service receipts.

subfiles.title: RCA request to convert Korean won from communications service
subfiles.about: Requests arrangements to convert won collected from RCA’s Korean radio service into dollars.
subfiles.summary: RCA recounts how its Korea–United States radio circuit was established and describes its operating receipts, costs, and accumulated won. It says it will resume accepting won payments once conversion arrangements are made.

subfiles.title: Department letter to RCA on Korean telegraph service
subfiles.about: Discusses extending telegraph service to Korean civilians.
subfiles.summary: Opening page of a letter about Korean civilian telegraph service.
